cws.title: Google Photos Delete Tool – Duplicate Finder & Bulk Delete
cws.summary: Find and delete duplicate photos in Google Photos. Bulk delete safely: dry run, batches, empty trash. Private, open source.
description: Find duplicates: Google Photos only removes exact copies of the same file. This extension also finds look-alike copies (resized, re-saved, slightly edited, or uploaded twice) in the view you choose. It scrolls the view, compares small thumbnails on your computer, and shows look-alikes in groups. The best copy is kept, the rest are marked for Trash, and you can switch any photo. A similarity slider sets how strict the match is. Nothing is uploaded.

Google Photos has no “delete all”. This extension automates the tedious select → trash → confirm loop in safe batches of up to 500, so you can reclaim storage in minutes. Everything runs in your browser: it clicks the same UI elements a human would click, and it stops the moment it cannot positively identify a button.
Safety model (non-negotiable)
Fail-closed matching: the delete, confirm, and empty-trash buttons are matched by multilingual keywords against aria-labels and tooltips. An unknown UI means stop and error, never a guess.
Consent gate: the first real (non-dry) run requires you to confirm what you are about to do. Nothing is ever scheduled or unattended.
60-day Trash: deleted photos go to the Google Photos Trash, where they stay for 60 days. “Empty trash afterwards” is opt-in, permanent, and only reported done after the trash is verified empty.
Instant stop: pause, resume, or stop anytime; a stopped run never reports a false error.
Features
Batch delete: up to 500 per batch (Google's selection cap), auto-scroll, and the final partial batch is flushed.
Dry run: scroll-and-count mode that never clicks anything; Pro adds a per-type breakdown.
Empty trash (opt-in): navigates to /trash, empties it, and verifies the postcondition.
Type filters (Pro): delete only screenshots, videos, animations, collages, or photos.
Date filter (Pro): delete only items before a date, after a date, or between two dates; combines with the type filter.
9-language extension UI, compile-time-complete translations.
Self-diagnosing reports: the Report issue button opens a pre-filled GitHub issue with a structured diagnostic blob, so UI drift becomes actionable data.
Free vs Pro

The delete engine, dry run, and empty trash are free forever. A one-time Pro license unlocks the analysis layer: type and date filters and the dry-run report/export. Verification is local (Ed25519) — no account, no backend, no telemetry.
Privacy
Zero data collection, zero servers, zero telemetry. Open source (MIT). Versioned selector packs make a UI-drift fix a data patch, not code surgery. Full statement: PRIVACY.md
Also available
Userscript for Tampermonkey / Violentmonkey (same engine, same safety model) and a Firefox add-on. Support: GitHub issues.
